ideas.pitch: A real-time predictive dashboard for Wolfline buses and campus parking decks using historical arrival logs and live GPS feeds to forecast crowding and suggest optimal commute routes for NC State students.
ideas.title: PackTransit Live: NC State Campus Bus & Parking Occupancy Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves every single day on the NC State campus, guaranteeing high engagement and immediate utility during live demos.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting platform that models peak electricity demand for local microgrids using historical weather data and industrial consumption metrics from the Raleigh area.
ideas.title: WolfGrid: AI-Driven Energy Load Predictor for Research Triangle Smart Grids
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous forecasting methodologies similar to winning AI incident predictors, appealing directly to judges looking for data-heavy, mathematically sound backends.

ideas.pitch: An automated logistics and outreach platform that groups isolated seniors in Wake County into shared social outings and pairs them with verified student volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: RaleighShelterConnect: AI Matchmaker for Local Volunteer Drivers and Seniors
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets clear measurable social impact with a quantified community benefit, mirroring the exact formula that won the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and logistics app that redirects surplus dining hall food from NC State eateries to student food pantries while generating healthy meal plans for recipients.
ideas.title: TriangleMealMatch: NC State Campus Food Insecurity & Dining Hall Rescue
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a campus-specific logistical pain point with personalized AI nutrition guidance, directly replicating the winning formula of the Hour Hackathon nutrition assistant.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered geospatial monitoring tool that analyzes periodic satellite imagery of Raleigh-Durham industrial corridors to detect zoning violations and environmental runoff changes.
ideas.title: PackAI Compliance: Satellite Monitoring for Triangle Industrial Land Use
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by processing complex geospatial data and computer vision models within the tight 31-hour timeframe.
